sentences.text:
The petitioner has filed the instant proceeding seeking quashing of the criminal proceeding pertaining to PRC No. 525/2024 under Section 498A IPC arising out of Dibrugarh PS Case No.
165/2024.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that multiple litigations are pending between the informant and the petitioner, who were married and one divorce proceeding is also pending.
It is submitted that efforts are on to arrive at some settlement regarding the multiple litigations and if the same is not done perhaps this matter can be taken up for hearing on the next date.
Learned counsel or the respondent submits that he does not object to effort of settlement but the matter is also pending for a while and earlier mediation had also failed.

In the meantime, call for the scanned TCR of PRC Case No. 525/2024 including case diary,
charge-sheet and other relevant documents.
List the matter on 28.05.2026.
Interim order passed earlier shall continue till the next date.
JUDGE
